title: Create a provisional decision batch
expected_summary: Creates a paired provisional decision graph, explores supported dependent choices, and keeps provisional recommendations out of final knowledge.

turns.user: Use spec-grilling-auto to review SPEC.md. Continue through dependent choices without waiting for me.
assertions: Creates .spec-grill/spec/decision-graph.ai.md and decision-graph.md with byte-identical content and review-status: pending.

Finds supported load-bearing choices, including the dependent reconnect policy, and gives stable IDs, evidence, assumptions, depends-on, and affects; keeps the configurable refresh time out of the tree.
Marks all new recommendations provisional and explains any credible alternatives without inventing filler alternatives.
Does not put a provisional ownership, conflict, or ID-scope decision into final specification, ADR, CONTEXT.md, or GLOSSARY.md knowledge.
